findings.summary: Fixed mobile menu button obscures the initial letters of each reference-page h1.
findings.detail: At 390 viewport pixels, the button around x12–48/y12–46 overlays the h1 text beginning at x20/y28. Desktop headings remain clear.
findings.suggested_resolution: Reserve mobile top clearance for the menu control, then refresh captures.

findings.summary: Missing ordinary spaces before inline math visibly join prose and symbols in glossary entries.
findings.detail: Examples include radiusr, most3r, vectorv, throughH, yieldsV, for0, andu, optimization,x and constantL. KaTeX glyphs themselves render legibly.
findings.suggested_resolution: Insert ordinary spaces before the opening inline-math delimiters in the author fragment, rebuild, then refresh captures.

findings.summary: Glossary term Counterexample is orphaned at the end of print page1 while its definition starts page2.
findings.suggested_resolution: Consider break-after:avoid on glossary dt in print CSS.

findings.summary: Contents entries display two numbering schemes at once.
findings.detail: Ordered-list markers combine with chapter labels, producing 1. 0., 2. A. and later 1. 4. This remains legible but can distract from chapter numbering.

findings.summary: Existing editorial join PrimersA–D is visible in the book project introduction.
findings.detail: Add a space between Primers and A–D when repairing nearby prose.
